newsitem.title: USA: Westchester Cty, N.Y., cancels $20 mln RANs sale.
newsitem.headline: Westchester Cty, N.Y., cancels $20 mln RANs sale.

text.p: Westchester County, N.Y., on Wednesday said that it canceled a planned sale of up to $20 million of revenue anticipation notes slated for the week of December 16 as the state agreed to pay it $15.4 million.

The aid from the state includes payments from mandated programs, like Medicaid and education and transportation for disabled children, and is in addition to state reimbursements of $11.1 million that previously were announced.

While the 1996 budget is expected to produce a year-end surplus of around the same size as the last two years, the county had risked ending the year with a cash flow shortfall because the state had not paid it money that was owed, according to a joint statement released by the County Executive and the County Finance Commissioner.
